How to Use a Cookie Scoop for Uniform Mini Pizza Rolls

In the world of appetizers, mini pizza rolls are a crowd-pleaser, and with the right equipment, they can be perfectly uniform, too. When it comes to portion control and precision, a cookie scoop is the perfect tool, and we're going to show you how to use it to create cookie scoop mini pizza rolls.

Our top pick for a cookie scoop is the Cookie Dough Scoop: Perfectly uniform cookies, meatballs, and muffins — spring-release scoops in every size.

Step 1: Prepare Your Dough

The first step in making mini pizza rolls is to make the dough. You can use a pre-made pizza dough or make your own from scratch. If you're short on time, a pre-made dough is a great option. If you have a few extra minutes, making your own dough will give you more control over the ingredients and the flavor. Either way, make sure the dough is at room temperature and easy to work with.

Step 2: Chill the Dough

Once you have your dough ready, it's time to chill it in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. This will help the dough relax and become easier to work with. You can also chill it for several hours or even overnight for a more pronounced flavor.

Step 3: Roll Out the Dough

When the dough is chilled, it's time to roll it out to a thickness of about 1/4 inch. You can use a rolling pin or your hands to achieve the right consistency. Make sure the dough is evenly rolled out and there are no air pockets or bubbles.

Step 4: Scoop the Dough

Now it's time to use the cookie scoop to portion out the dough. Place the cookie scoop into the dough and press down gently to release a perfect sphere of dough. The spring-release feature of the Cookie Dough Scoop will help you achieve uniform scoops every time. Continue scooping the dough until you have a batch of mini pizza rolls.

Step 5: Shape the Rolls

Once you have your dough scooped, it's time to shape the mini pizza rolls. You can use a rolling pin or your hands to flatten the dough into a circle or oval shape. Place a spoonful of pizza sauce in the center of each roll and top with shredded mozzarella cheese and any other toppings you like.

Step 6: Bake the Rolls

Place the mini pizza rolls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in a preheated oven at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly. You can also use a pizza stone in the oven to achieve a crispy crust.

Step 7: Serve and Enjoy

Your perfectly uniform cookie scoop mini pizza rolls are now ready to be served. You can enjoy them on their own or as part of a larger meal. They're perfect for parties, game days, or any occasion when you want to impress your guests.

FAQ

What size cookie scoop should I use for mini pizza rolls?

The size of the cookie scoop will depend on the size of the mini pizza rolls you want to make. A smaller scoop will give you smaller rolls, while a larger scoop will give you larger rolls. The Cookie Dough Scoop comes in a range of sizes, so choose the one that's right for you.

Can I use the cookie scoop for other types of dough?

Yes, the cookie scoop is not just for cookie dough. You can use it for any type of dough that needs to be portioned out, such as meatball dough or muffin batter.

How often should I clean and maintain the cookie scoop?

You should clean and maintain the cookie scoop after each use to prevent the buildup of dough and bacteria. Wash it with soap and water and dry it thoroughly to prevent rust and corrosion.
